description.value: The King Edward Hotel & Motel is the primary full-service accommodation in remote Stewart, BC — a small border town at the end of the Portland Canal opposite Alaska's Misty Fiords National Park. The property offers a range of room types including kitchenette suites with outside entrances, an on-site pub, café, and licensed outdoor patio. Stewart sits at the end of the Glacier Highway and serves as a key resupply and rest point for cyclists riding the remote Stewart-Cassiar corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at kingedwardhotel.com is fully accessible and provides rich detail. Address (405 5th Avenue, Stewart, BC V0T 1W0), phone (250-636-2244), laundry ('coin operated laundry machines' / 'Guest Laundry Facility'), Wi-Fi ('free Wi-Fi', 'High Speed Internet'), and on-site food (Casey's Pub, Prospectors Pub, King Ed Cafe) are all confirmed from website text. Bike-specific amenities (secure storage, bike procedure, e-bike charging, pump, tools, bike wash) are not mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone — both sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed for phone and address cannot be verified against OSM.
OSM name is 'King Edward Hotel' but the website consistently identifies the property as 'King Edward Hotel & Motel'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible hotel in a remote cycling corridor town with a fully functional website and bookable rooms.
